summary: Verified per-qty freight fix end-to-end in the live UI for Simple quote SA-260617-135543. After clicking btn-freight-update, the Quote Table 'Freight' column shows THREE DIFFERENT, monotonically increasing values across qty 500/1000/2000, and the Freight Dashboard Per-Item view renders three distinct slots each with its own weight + skid count. Single-qty regression on a fresh tab also passes. Multi-Part regression was skipped per request (no easily-loadable MP quote, not the focus of the fix).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-qty freight is fully working end-to-end for Simple quotes. Reference numbers for quote SA-260617-135543 / ZIP 92618 / 30.75x33.5 / ECT32-B: qty 500 → 583 lbs · 2 skids · $447.08 raw / $514.14 markup; qty 1000 → 1091 lbs · 3 skids · $565.89 / $650.77; qty 2000 → 2182 lbs · 6 skids · $900.24 / $1,035.28. The freight Update can take 20–60s for 3 qty tiers; in this run it completed in ~5s thanks to the chunked batch. The Multi-Part Individual mode loop was not re-verified in the live UI this iteration (no MP quote pre-staged); recommend adding a small MP fixture in Team Saved Quotes if MP regression coverage matters for the next iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix verified. updateFreight() now iterates every populated qty in the Single-Part branch, fires one UTS quote per qty (chunked in batches of 4 server-side), populates state.freightByQty[slot] AND freightDashCache.perItemQuotes[slot]. useEngine forwards freightByQty in the payload; runner.build_prod_inputs() resolves it with JSON string keys so each Quote Table row picks up its own freight (and only falls back to flat freightCost when a slot is missing). Distinct Quote Table values and distinct Dashboard per-slot weights/skids confirm both backend and frontend changes are wired correctly.
